subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native provenance contract should durable OpenClaw memory use across memory-core, QMD, MEMORY.md promotion, Memory Wiki bridge inputs, and review/edit flows?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but durable record shape, source authority, merge/edit lineage, and cross-plugin ownership are product and architecture choices that should not be chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Schema Foundation First
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 the schema prerequisite, then implement provenance once record and revision ownership are settled.

options.title: Use Memory Wiki As Optional Provenance Layer
options.body: Document Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional path while leaving active memory's native promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest available history signal for the memory host SDK and memory-core boundary where this contract would be defined.
